user.title: Add a Nesto Panel
user.description: Enter the panel's address. It's shown on the panel under Settings → About.

data_description.host: The panel's IP address or host name.
data_description.port: The panel's port; 6170 unless you changed it.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Pair with {name}
zeroconf_confirm.description: Pair Home Assistant with {name}? The panel will show a six-digit code.

pair.title: Pair with {name}
pair.description: Type the six-digit code the panel shows. It stays on screen for two minutes.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair {name} again
reauth_confirm.description: {name} doesn't accept Home Assistant's key any more: someone chose Forget on it, or paired it with another Home Assistant. If it shows a pairing code or 'Not paired', continue. Otherwise choose Settings → Pair on the panel first, then continue.

data_description.host: The panel's IP address or host name.
data_description.port: The panel's port; 6170 unless you changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the panel. Check the address, and that the panel is on.
error.insecure: The panel is a development build without encryption, which Home Assistant doesn't accept.
error.pairing_closed: The panel is already paired. Choose Settings → Pair on the panel, then try again.
error.pairing_failed: The panel rejected the pairing. Submit again to start over with a new code.
error.pairing_timeout: The pairing timed out. Submit again for a new code.
error.unsupported_protocol: The panel speaks a protocol version this integration doesn't. Update the panel's firmware or the integration.
error.wrong_code: That's not the code the panel showed. The panel now shows a new one: type that.

abort.already_configured: This panel is already set up.
abort.not_a_panel: This device doesn't announce itself as a Nesto Panel.
abort.wrong_device: A different panel answers at that address.

data_description.mode: The room: what's in the area you put the panel in, kept up to date as you move entities or the panel. Or entities you pick yourself.

room.title: The {area} room
room.description: The panel shows the lights, switches, fans, scenes, scripts, climate and covers in {area}. To show another room, move the panel to that area on its device page.

data_description.exclude: Entities in {area} the panel shouldn't show.
data_description.sensors: Sensors to show too, read only: a room's sensors aren't shown unless you pick them here.

room_no_area.title: The panel's room
room_no_area.description: The panel isn't in an area yet, so it shows nothing. Put it in one on its device page: it then shows the lights, switches, fans, scenes, scripts, climate and covers there.

data_description.sensors: Sensors to show too, read only: a room's sensors aren't shown unless you pick them here.

manual.title: Pick the entities
manual.description: The panel shows these, grouped by kind: lights, climate, covers, switches, scenes and sensors. With two or more lights it adds an 'All lights' item.

data_description.entities: Lights, switches, input booleans, fans without speed control, scenes, scripts, climate, covers and sensors. At most 48.

options.low: Low: a badge on the home screen, no pop-up
options.normal: Normal: pops up, wakes the panel from standby
options.high: High: also wakes the panel when its screen is off
options.critical: Critical: stays until answered, beeps every 30 seconds

auth_failed.message: {name} at {host} doesn't accept the pairing key.

bad_button.message: The button "{label}" needs a label with letters or digits, different from the others.

panel_not_loaded.message: {name} isn't set up; check its entry.

too_long.message: The {field} is too long: the panel takes {limit} characters at most.

too_many_buttons.message: Too many buttons: the panel shows {limit} at most.

unknown_panel.message: There's no Nesto Panel with entry {entry_id}.

unsupported_protocol.message: {name} at {host} speaks protocol version {version}, which this integration doesn't.

unsupported_protocol.title: {name} needs an update
unsupported_protocol.description: {name} speaks version {version} of the Nesto Panel protocol, which this version of the integration doesn't. Update the integration, or the panel's firmware, so both speak the same version. Home Assistant will connect again once you reload the panel's entry.

notify.name: Show a notification
notify.description: Shows a notification on a Nesto Panel, with buttons if you like. Returns its ID.

config_entry_id.name: Panel
config_entry_id.description: The panel to show it on.

id.name: ID
id.description: Sending again with the same ID replaces that notification. Home Assistant makes one up if you leave it out.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Seconds it stays on screen before going to the list; 0 means until dismissed.

beep.name: Beep
beep.description: The sound when it arrives. Silent when the panel's notification sounds are off, except for critical ones.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Shown with it, as the closest of the panel's built-in icons; left out if none is close.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: Up to 3 labels. A press sends the label's ID ("Open" sends open) in the Notification event.

clear_notification.name: Clear notifications
clear_notification.description: Removes a notification from a Nesto Panel, or all of them.

id.name: ID
id.description: The notification to remove; leave it out to remove them all.
